record_identity.title: Taiwan reported an AI-assisted cyber campaign against government agencies

incident_identity.date_basis: Best available report or publication date preserved in the selected source; it is not asserted as an independently verified event timestamp.

summary: Reuters reports Taiwan’s Ministry of Digital Affairs confirmed AI-assisted attacks from overseas sources; private firm Dream separately reported multi-agent credential theft and data exfiltration. The government statement did not attribute the attack to China.

vigil_assessment.factual_basis: The selected evidence reports: Reuters reports Taiwan’s Ministry of Digital Affairs confirmed AI-assisted attacks from overseas sources; private firm Dream separately reported multi-agent credential theft and data exfiltration. The government statement did not attribute the attack to China.

vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: For CAM, this occurrence shows that the government confirmed an overseas AI-assisted attack campaign, while private investigators separately supplied multi-agent, credential-theft, exfiltration, and attribution claims that remain attributed rather than government-confirmed. Controls should preserve evidence, authority state, escalation and contestability across the full affected pathway.
assessment_boundaries: Taiwan confirmed the AI-assisted attack but not all private-firm quantitative claims.
Human operators selected objectives; autonomous target selection is not established.
Incident admission does not determine legal liability or establish every disputed claim as final fact.
